headline: Revenue grows but margins and earnings per share slip
summary_short: Revenue of $9.45B rose 5% q/q and 6% y/y, but GAAP EPS of $0.49 fell 2% y/y and EPS excluding charges of $0.64 fell 7% y/y.
summary_long: Pretax margin was 10.8% versus 11.4% last quarter. Adjusted EBITDA was $2.07B, essentially flat y/y. Cash flow from operations was $1.51B and free cash flow $828M. SLB repurchased 12.9M shares for $656M and the board approved a $0.295 quarterly dividend. It signed an agreement to acquire Kelvion to expand its Data Center Solutions business. Full-year capital investment is still expected at about $2.5B.
confidence_notes: EPS excluding charges and credits, adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow are non-GAAP. Management points to Middle East activity weighing on results and a recovery as upside; the release's causal detail beyond that was not itemized here.

drivers.explanation: Revenue increased 5% sequentially and 6% year on year per the release.
Increased 9% sequentially but was essentially flat year on year.
CEO references a compelling outlook for 2027 with further upside as Middle East activity recovers.
